claim.quote: we successfully detected both characteristic emissions from $^{37}$Ar decay (2.82 keV and 270 eV) and achieved unprecedented energy threshold performance in TREX-DM, approaching the single-electron ionization energy of argon.

name: Low-energy threshold demonstration for dark matter searches in TREX-DM with an $^{37}$Ar source produced at CNA HiSPANoS
notes: Date: first arXiv submission (v1, 7 Oct 2025); the abstract quoted is that of the latest arXiv version (v2, last revised 23 Dec 2025).

published.quote: Journal of Cosmology and Astroparticle Physics, Volume 2026, April 2026

summary.plain: TREX-DM was calibrated with a radioactive argon-37 source and, with a new readout, saw the 270 eV emission of argon, close to the energy of a single ionisation electron.
summary.technical: 37Ar produced by fast-neutron activation of CaO powder at the HiSPANoS facility (CNA, Seville), O(1) kBq; detected in the TREX-DM chamber with a combined GEM-Micromegas readout. Published in J. Cosmol. Astropart. Phys. 2026 (April).

title: Low-energy threshold demonstration for dark matter searches in TREX-DM with an $^{37}$Ar source produced at CNA HiSPANoS
why_it_matters: The abstract frames this as a low-energy threshold demonstration for low-mass dark matter searches.
